title: one and only discard custom exceptions that evaluate to false
provenance: Evaluator-authored problem-only adaptation of the upstream PR description, retrieved 2026-10-05. Not an authenticated pre-fix issue snapshot. Solution text and comments omitted.
body: A custom exception instance may define __bool__ to return False. one([], too_short=that_exception), one([1, 2], too_long=that_exception), and only([1, 2], too_long=that_exception) must raise that exact supplied exception instance, but currently raise ValueError instead. Supplying a custom too_long exception must also work when the iterable's elements have a __repr__ that raises: no default error message is needed in that situation. Preserve normal one-item results, only's empty default, and default ValueError behavior when no exception is supplied. Add regression tests.
